Veloka

The campus moves together

Placed exactly where students need them, at hostels, academic blocks, and food courts, Veloka's electric bicycles come with real-time GPS, smart sensors, live battery tracking, and seamless booking. Every ride is visible, reliable, and secure. And with pay-per-ride pricing, getting around campus is finally affordable for everyone.

This isn't just another bike-sharing system. It's a rethink of campus transport built on smarter placement, smarter technology, and a design that puts students first.

🚲 Built for campus rides

Four details that make pooling a Veloka bike across LPU something you can actually trust.

📍

Never far, never missing

Charging stations at every building, hostel, block, food court, so the nearest bike is a min walk, not a 15-min trek.

☕

Cheaper than your chai

Low deposit, pay-per-ride pricing built for every student's budget, not a premium product for a few.

🗺️

Book it, don't chase it

Real-time slot booking, live battery %, and a map showing exactly which building has a ready bike.

📡

Always knows itself

GPS + smart sensors track live battery, location, and health, no bike sits broken and forgotten for months.

Four steps, one shared bike

From logging in to unlocking the bike — this is the sequence behind every ride.

1

Login

Sign in with your student registration ID, campus-only access, no random users.

2

Set your route

Pick your pickup point and destination on the map.

3

Pay the fare

See the ride cost upfront and pay in-app before you unlock.

4

Unlock with your phone

The nearest bike gets a one-time signal to open its lock, no key, no card, no waiting.

How the stations work 🚲

Smart infrastructure built for a campus that never sleeps.

🚲

One stand, every building

Power stations aren't hostel-only, they're placed at hostels, academic blocks, and food courts alike, doubling as the cycle stand itself. No separate stand, no separate charger, one structure does both.

🏢 Every building type · 🔌 Stand + charger in one
🚲

Parks itself into a charge

Charging ports sit on either side of the front wheel. Line the bike up in the dock and it starts charging automatically. No cable, no plug, no extra step for the rider.

🔌 Auto-charging dock · 🚲 No cables, no plugs

🚲 Veloka

Veloka is a pooled bike-sharing concept — smart-locked bikes, solar-fed stations, and live fleet telemetry, matching riders heading the same way. This site presents the idea; booking and matching live in the companion app.
